ctx._config is None is the wrong signal. RegistrationContext.fork() copies base_states but resets _config to None, so a forked context re-triggers the same StateValueError. This is the path AppHarness takes.
The _config_module_deps_root != project_root branch is not exercised; with the comparison removed, all 118 tests in test_config.py still pass.
Both calls use reload_dependencies=True, so this test passes on main too and does not cover the new root check.

P1: When a package's __init__.py defines a registered rx.State, this reload creates a replacement class while RegistrationContext retains the original. Skip reloading package modules that are themselves registered state modules. (suggested fix: `if dep not in state_modules: importlib.reload(...)`)
